build_pipeline_from_config: build a pipeline from a PipelineConfig with configurable thread count and failure tolerance
run_pipeline_in_subprocess: run a pipeline in a subprocess and iterate over results across multiple epochs
run_pipeline_in_subinterpreter: run a pipeline in a subinterpreter and iterate over results for multi-epoch training
set_default_build_callback: set a callback function that is invoked with the PipelineConfig each time a pipeline is built
get_default_build_callback: get the currently registered default build callback function or None if not set
